title: Sonia Citron and Kiki Iriafen added to 2026 USA Basketball Women’s National Team Roster - USA Basketball
excerpt: USA Basketball announced today that Sonia Citron and Kiki Iriafen have been added to 2026 USA Women’s National Team, which will compete at the 2026 FIBA Women’s World Cup set to begin in Berlin on Sept. 4.
